notes: New: you choose what the window's buttons do (Settings, General, 'Window'). The close button (X) now minimizes Breezy to the taskbar instead of closing it, so a click on X no longer stops anything: Breezy and its tasks keep running. It can also hide Breezy in the tray (the small icons next to the clock), or close Breezy as it did before. The minimize button can minimize to the taskbar, as it always did, or hide Breezy in the tray.

To close Breezy for real, use the new 'Quit Breezy' button in the same place, or right-click Breezy's tray icon and choose 'Quit Breezy'. Both ask first when tasks are running. An update that is waiting to be installed still installs when you press X, and Windows shutting down still closes Breezy.
A window that filled the screen fills it again when Breezy is brought back from the tray.
